initial_decision.brief_rationale: The standardized difference is 0.14, but the received checks establish arithmetic accuracy rather than causal identification. Request archived design record R217-2 to assess whether adjustment for Z identifies the average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R217-2 supplies conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the population causal effect by standardization over Z. The risk difference is 0.4(0.4−0.5)+0.6(0.9−0.6)=0.14.
